title: DEC-240 CI hardening: remaining low and info findings from the OMARK-102 round-1 review (not started)
description: Filed from the Opus round-1 review of opum-ai/opum-marketplace#235 (OMARK-102), relayed by the leader 2026-10-28. All predate that PR and none is started. Relayed wording, not read from the reviewer record. LOW-3: the workflow-hardening rules run per line, not per command, and comments are not stripped, so an npm ci with the flag followed by && npm rebuild passes, and an npm install with the flag only inside a trailing comment passes. LOW-4: layout evasions of the line reader: a run key with two spaces after the dash, a quoted run key, a flow-style mapping, run with an indentation indicator or a trailing comment after the block marker, and *.yaml workflow files skipped by the .yml filter. LOW-5 remainder: extensions.worktreeConfig with a .git/config.worktree file evades --local; url insteadOf rewrites, a token in remote.origin.url and credential.helper are INFO only. LOW-6: a whitespace-only managed block reports no Quest CLI line instead of empty. LOW-2 remainder: npm subcommands the pattern does not list (update, dedupe, audit fix, link, install abbreviations, ic, sit, init, create) and quoted or path-prefixed npm. PROPOSAL, not a decision: a job-level npm_config_ignore_scripts set to true would make the lint a backstop instead of the only control. That is a CI-design change for the leader and opum-doc to decide.

acceptanceCriteria.text: each listed finding is fixed or recorded as declined with a reason
a fixture or mutant proves each fixed finding both ways in the suite itself
the npm_config_ignore_scripts proposal is decided or declined by its owner and the answer recorded

implementationNotes: ROUND-2 REVIEW ADDITIONS 2026-10-28, relayed by the leader from the r2 Opus unit; wording is the relay, not the reviewer record. (1) LOW: the whole-line comment strip in assert-main-fast-forward.test.sh (near line 445) hides a real reference inside a YAML block scalar or a run pipe body, for example an AUTH key with a pipe value followed by a hash-prefixed secrets reference. Cheap fix proposed: drop the strip, since the guard job is silent without it, and move that clean fixture into the firing set. (2) LOW: the token scan covers only the guard job slice. A workflow-level env holding a secret is inherited, a join over github.* expression gets through, and so does an expression split across lines. (3) LOW: npm install -g --ignore-scripts false "x" evades the allowlist because nopt reads the next word as the value. (4) INFO: a non-space prefix stuck to the flag (empty quotes or a backslash before --ignore-scripts=false) hides it from the occurrence scan.

OMARK-106 DELIVERED (PR on chore/omark-106-ci-hardening-remainder). FIXED, each proven both ways in the suites (rejecting fixture + accepting fixture, and mutants of the check red on the predicted subset): LOW-3 per-command + comment-stripped npm rule (workflow-hardening.test.mjs); LOW-4 layouts: multi-space dash, quoted run key, block header with indentation indicator/chomping/trailing comment, flow-style refused outright, *.yaml now read; LOW-2 remainder: update/up/upgrade/dedupe/ddp/audit fix/link/ln/init/innit/create, install abbreviations, ic/sit, quoted and path-prefixed npm; LOW-5 config.worktree read by assert-no-persisted-credential.sh; LOW-6 whitespace-only managed block reports empty (read-quest-version.sh); R2-1 whole-line comment strip dropped from the token scan; R2-2 token scan now reads the whole promotion-guards.yml plus github.*, bare github handed to a function, and a split-across-lines expression; R2-3 bare --ignore-scripts followed by true/false/null/number refused; R2-4 a token with a stuck prefix is not the bare flag and is refused.

DECLINED, with reasons: LOW-5 INFO items (url insteadOf rewrites, a token in remote.origin.url, credential.helper) - INFO only in the review and none is the actions/checkout persistence mechanism this check measures; npm run/test/start/pack/publish/version not treated as risky - they run the root package own scripts, not a dependency lifecycle script, and listing them would flag every legitimate script call. OPEN: AC 3, the npm_config_ignore_scripts job-level proposal, is a CI-design decision for the leader and opum-doc and is NOT decided here; task stays In Progress until that answer is recorded.

ROUND-1 REVIEW OF #243 (Opus, 8bf321d): B1 (comment strip hid a whole command) and B2 (lookahead missed subshell/$()/backtick/redirect forms) fixed with rejecting fixtures, each confirmed to fail on 8bf321d. Nit 4 taken (npm run/test accepted; npm run ci is a script named ci), nit 5 taken (unparseable config.worktree fails closed), nit 6 taken (depth_raw renamed wf_raw). KNOWN, not fixed: nit 3 - flow-style refusal does not cover a quoted run key inside a flow list, or a flow list whose bracket opens on its own line; nit 7 (pre-existing) - a dash-only step line, a run value continued onto the next line, a folded run > block splitting npm and ci, run: &anchor |, and --ignore-scripts $VAR are not read. These lexical evasions are what the npm_config_ignore_scripts proposal (AC 3) would make moot.
